fact: Car 11 collided with Car 14 at Turn 3 on Lap 2.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. Car 11 attempted to overtake Car 14 on the inside of Turn 3. However, Car 11 had not established its front axle at least alongside the mirror of Car 14 prior to and at the apex. Car 11 made contact with the right-rear of Car 14, causing Car 14 to spin. The Stewards determined that Car 11 was wholly at fault for the collision and therefore imposed the standard of a 10 second time penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 11 Causing A Collision With Car 14
to: The Team Manager, Cadillac Formula 1 Team
